# Binary VAR numerical reference

The NPZ and JSON store a deterministic CPU run of the Bernoulli/DisARM trainer before the single-API refactor (source commit 7a2a609). Data are generated by NumPy default_rng(751), shape24x3; training arguments are explicit in test_disarm_regression.py. The files contain synthetic data-derived weights, coefficients, graph and losses. Capture environment: Python3.12, NumPy2.5.4, PyTorch2.15.0+cpu. Model keys and outputs are compared with floating-point tolerances so dependency-specific arithmetic is not mistaken for a structural change.
